name: Mixology
source: This is not just any drinking game! Welcome to the Mixology Hostess Club, dear customer! You seem to have accidentally stumbled upon this club but, oh well! Time for drinks and most importantly... the hostesses! Chat them up, buy them drinks and learn their stories. Successfully woo them and you could become more than just a customer!
translation: 这可不是普通的喝酒游戏！亲爱的客人，欢迎来到Mixology陪酒俱乐部！你似乎是不小心误闯进来的，不过，既来之则安之！是时候喝上一杯，更重要的是……认识这里的女招待们！与她们聊天，请她们喝酒，了解她们的故事。若能成功赢得芳心，你们的关系或许就不止于顾客与女招待了！
